business_problem: Hapag-Lloyd needed to reduce manual work in corporate audits because producing findings and executive summaries from bullet points was time-consuming and inconsistent.
solution_summary: Hapag-Lloyd uses Databricks Data + AI Platform, Databricks Model Serving, MLflow, and Agent Bricks to support GenAI audit summarization and documentation. Hapag-Lloyd needed to reduce manual work in corporate audits because producing findings and executive summaries from bullet points was time-consuming and inconsistent. In practice, the implementation coordinates repeatable workflows with Agent Bricks, runs transformation or AI logic on Databricks Data + AI Platform, and delivers outputs through Databricks Model Serving. Documents, notes, and structured records are consolidated into a governed cloud data layer; pipeline execution is coordinated with Agent Bricks; Databricks Data + AI Platform applies analytics or model logic; results are surfaced through Databricks Model Serving.
